# realizes

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:realizes`](gmeow-realizes.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/realizes>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) to the [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) it realizes. Non-functional: an omnibus or aggregate [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) may realize multiple Works (e.g. an anthology). Inverse of [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](gmeow-realizedThrough.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) -> [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:realizes`](gmeow-realizes.md) from [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) to [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to climb from an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) up to the abstract [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) it realizes — the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md)→[`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) R-relation of the WEMI spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the embodiment of an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) in an edition (use [`gmeow:embodiedIn`](gmeow-embodiedIn.md)) and for derivation between distinct works (use [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md)); a cover or arrangement is a new Work-or-Expression, not a re-realization.

### How to use

- Assert from the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) to the [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md); an anthology [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) may realize several Works (non-functional). Read the inverse [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](gmeow-realizedThrough.md) for Work-rooted traversal.
